name: AbbVie Inc.
summary:
AbbVie (ABBV) reported earnings of $3.65 per share on revenue of $16.99 billion for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $3.64 per share on revenue of $16.81 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $3.70 per share. The company missed expectations by 1.35% while revenue grew 10.16% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects 2026 earnings of $13.87 to $14.07 per share, including items. The company's previous guidance was earnings of $13.91 to $14.11 per share, and the current consensus earnings estimate is $14.14 per share for the year ending December 31, 2026.

AbbVie Inc is a research-based biopharmaceutical company. Its products are used to treat diseases including rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, Crohn' disease, HIV, cystic fibrosis complications.
subject: AbbVie Missed Expectations

name: Eaton Corp.
summary:
